name.zh: 餐厅同伴分析绯闻与珠雫怒击史黛菈
name.en: Allies Analyze the Scandal and Shizuku Strikes Stella

periods.summary: Stella, Alice, Kagami and Shizuku discuss how the media is being pressured by the Ethics Committee and why expulsion is hard without a confession. Stella blames herself and suggests breaking up with Ikki, prompting Shizuku to fire an ice spear at her.
periods.cause: Ikki remains detained and the scandal coverage makes Stella fear she is harming him.
periods.process: Kagami explains the media coercion and League expulsion policy. Shizuku says Ikki is enduring the investigation because he refuses to let outsiders degrade his relationship with Stella; she warns Stella never to betray that resolve.
periods.outcome: Stella apologizes and regains resolve, while Kurono summons her to discuss strategy.
periods.significance: Transforms Stella's guilt into determination and shows Shizuku accepting the Ikki-Stella bond despite rivalry.
